newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Tuesday, with poor buying interest and declines in Malaysia keeping activity thin.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,405-10 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening but lower than Monday's close of 1,410-15 rupiah, but trades were also done at 1,400.
The traders said there was likely to be a tender for 1,000 tonnes of crude palm oil in the North Sumatran capital of Medan on Wednesday, which should give some price direction.
"There was not much interest in the market today because of the elections, and falls in Malaysia," one trader said.
"Players continue to remain cautious ahead of polling on Thursday, and are keeping stock levels low by buying just enough for immediate needs," the trader said.

The traders said they expected market activity to return to normal next week, but added that prices were likely to remain under pressure. The market had been subdued during most of the 27 days of campaigning which was marred by the worst political violence in the three decades of President Suharto's rule.
